segment.source: Renders the tier that has no number: a panel saying what large customers get — security review, single sign-on, a named contact, custom terms, an invoice on account — and asking them to start a conversation instead of a checkout. Use it for: the fourth box beside three priced tiers, the foot of a plans page, a public-sector landing page. Prefer 'Plan Card' when the price is public, and 'Quote Request Panel' when the ask is a written estimate rather than a meeting.
